changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql: ALTER VIEW reporting.[Rules_All] AS SELECT A.ID AS AssetID, A.ObjectID AS ID, A.DisplayValue AS Name, A.TypeID AS RuleTypeID, A.TypeName AS RuleType, '-1' as RuleDimensionID, '' as RuleDimensionName, R.Threshold, '' as Status, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy FROM dbo.AssetDetail AS A INNER JOIN dbo.[Rule] AS R ON R.ID = A.ObjectID AND A.AssetTypeClass = 7 AND A.State = 1
changeSet.rollback: ALTER VIEW reporting.[Rules_All] AS SELECT A.ID AS AssetID, A.ObjectID AS ID, A.DisplayValue AS Name, A.TypeID AS RuleTypeID, A.TypeName AS RuleType, R.RuleDimensionID, RD.Name AS RuleDimensionName, R.Threshold, R.Status, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy FROM dbo.AssetDetail AS A INNER JOIN dbo.[Rule] AS R ON R.ID = A.ObjectID AND A.AssetTypeClass = 7 AND A.State = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN RuleDimension AS RD ON RD.ID = R.RuleDimensionID
